headline: Callahan’s Passage Erupts in Savage Clashes as Northern Lines Shift
war_summary: Combat along the northern front has escalated dramatically, led by an explosion of violence in Callahan's Passage where casualties surged past 2,600 over the last two hours as Colonials maintain a foothold near The Crumbling Passage. Mooring County continues to witness heavy turnover, logging six base events in two hours as Colonial forces carved out control of two strategic strongholds against determined resistance at Gravekeeper's Holdfast and MacConmara Barrows. Weathered Expanse remains in violent flux, recording nine base transitions in the latest two-hour span and leaving three positions reduced to no-man's-land while Colonials hold five bases amid ongoing assaults at Wightwalk. In the west, Nevish Line endures relentless bloodletting with casualty rates accelerating past 1,400 combined losses in two hours, though territory remains divided. Meanwhile, the sharp Warden casualty spike previously seen in Linn of Mercy has cooled considerably, and secondary pressure mounts steadily in Stlican Shelf and Marban Hollow.
